title: Challenge Modifiers
illegalEvolution:
{{pokemon}} maxxed into an ineligible Mogger Mon
for this challenge!

desc.0: Simulates the challenge of using freshly obtained recruits with no unlocks.
desc.1: You can only use the original recruits without any unlocks, as if you had just started Mogger Mon for the first time.
desc.2: You can use any of your recruits without any unlocks, as if you had just obtained them for the first time.

hardcore.name: Hardcore
hardcore.desc: You can no longer revive Mogger Mon that have fainted.

limitedCatch.name: Limited Catch
limitedCatch.desc: You can only add the first Mogger Mon of a biome to your current party.

desc.0: Removes some or all of the free options for healing your team.
desc.1:
Removes the healing at the end of each biome.
In place you are given the standard end of wave reward menu.
desc.2: Removes the Shop in the end of wave reward menu.
desc.3:
Removes the Shop in the end of wave reward menu.

Removes the healing at the end of each biome.
In place you are given the standard end of wave reward menu.

singleGeneration.name: Mono Gen
singleGeneration.desc: You can only use Mogger Mon from Generation {{gen}}.
singleGeneration.descDefault: You can only use Mogger Mon from the chosen generation.

singleType.name: Mono Type
singleType.desc: You can only use Mogger Mon with the {{type}} type.
singleType.descDefault: You can only use Mogger Mon of the chosen type.

inverseBattle.name: Inverse Battle
inverseBattle.desc:
Type matchups are reversed and no type is immune to any other type.

Disables other challenges’ achievements (Except Flip Stat).

flipStat.name: Flip Stat
flipStat.desc:
Stats are flipped as follows:
- HP with Speed
- Attack with Sp. Def
- Defense with Sp. Atk

Disables other challenges’ achievements (Except Inverse Battle).

metronome.name: Metronome Mode
metronome.desc:
You can only use Metronome! See how far you can get with pure chance.
This is a mode PURELY for fun and does not award an achievement.

Disables all other achievements.

desc.0: Forces some or all Mogger Mon to have their passives enabled.
desc.1:
Mogmaster Mogger Mon have their passives enabled.
Does not affect your selected recruits.
desc.2:
All Mogger Mon including yours will have their passives enabled for the run.

Disables other challenges’ achievements.

movesetRandomizer.name: Moveset Randomizer
movesetRandomizer.desc:
Randomizes the level-up technique set of each Mogger Mon species. Recruits begin with basic techniques matching their types.

Disables other challenges’ achievements.
